messages:
maria: FYI preprod promote is stalled in CI, looks like cache lease starvation on the artifact store :hourglass:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempt for promo/2026-03-21-09:22 triggered. Waiting for artifact leases...
sam: saw some 409s in the artifact upload logs earlier, maybe the multipart lease looped.
alex: any recent changes to the deploybot backoff?
maria: not from our side, last change was rate/ttl tuning last week. logs: `error: lease-acquire failed, status=409, attempts=8`
jess: can you paste the small log snippet?
maria: `upload/part-17: lease acquire conflict, owner=runner-42, retry_after=0.5s`
deploy-bot: auto-retry enabled, exponential backoff configured: max_attempts=10, jitter=0.2
sam: guess the backoff is too short — we have many parallel postsubmit jobs hitting the same artifact key. 
alex: is this blocking the release cut?
maria: yes, staging smoke depends on that artifact; until it's uploaded promote won't mark success. change window is today 15:00 UTC.
jess: can we manual-promote to previous good image to unblock the release window? :thinking_face:
sam: previous image is 2026-03-20-23:58, smoke passed. We could pin to that and follow up with a hotfix rollout.
alex: risk is missing the commit we wanted in this cut. but if we miss the window we'll slip the rollouts. ops decision?
maria: ops prefers not to delay customer-facing rollout. propose: pin promo to previous image, open a follow-up ticket to investigate lease starvation and increase lease TTL/backoff.
devops-bot: @oncall paging infra oncall (pagerduty): ARTIFACT_STORE_LEASE_STARVATION detected for project=promo-pipelines
sam: I'll take the manual pin. Doing `/deploybot pin --image 2026-03-20-2358 --reason "unblock release window, investigate lease conflicts"`
deploy-bot: Received pin command from sam. Initiating pin to image 2026-03-20-2358.
deploy-bot: Promotion to release-staging using pinned image started.
jess: pinging release docs, will add note in release_notes.md: "Pinned to previous image due to artifact lease conflict; CI upload retry loop under investigation."
alex: can infra check for hot path contending keys? maybe shard artifact prefixes?
devops-bot: oncall acknowledged. Escalating to infra team.
maria: thanks all — once pin is confirmed I'll update the release tracking spreadsheet and we can decide if we want a quick follow-up hotfix or wait for next cut. :thumbsup:
sam: pin confirmed — staging green for pinned image. Unblocking release window.
jess: creating follow-up ticket INFRA-1219 to track: "multipart lease starvation under high concurrency" and linking logs.
alex: after release, let's bump backoff to start at 1s and add jitter, and increase lease TTL from 30s -> 90s as a mitigation.
maria: agreed. I'll add to the ticket and assign to infra. Closing thread once INFRA-1219 created. :white_check_mark:
